response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM races AS r JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), ranked AS (SELECT raceId, race_name, average_points, result_count, average_points / AVG(average_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name) AS ratio FROM per_race) SELECT raceId, race_name, average_points, result_count, ratio FROM ranked ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
